reason: I pay a freelancer a few hundred a month and I know who is touching my customer data; an AI co-worker connected to my CRM and inbox from one LinkedIn ad is a big leap. The price is cheap next to my freelancer, but I'd book the demo at most, not sign up this week.
objection: 'GDPR-compliant' is one line on a page. Where is my customer data hosted, is it used to train models, who at FLUGIA can see it, and can I get a DPA signed before I connect my CRM?
would_change_my_mind: A signed DPA with EU-only hosting and no training on my data, plus a demo showing the AI Marketing Manager doing real work as well as my freelancer on my own accounts.
